title: Default test run at qnmttuprxxym
description: The default test run (python3 lib/tools/test_costs.py run: cargo test and every Python suite, the unit and tool tiers) at change qnmttuprxxym, "sync.py adopt-logs also takes the uploaded logs a workspace lacks, so its sessions' metrics are computed from the same l", queued to check the parallel run, the retry and the VF-032 fix end to end, in the workspace prove-setup. Nobody waits for it: the watcher or the next session reads the result, and sync.py push requires a passed run that covers the commit it pushes (verification/default_tests.py).
expected: exits 0: every test of the default run passes

resources.notes: the default run took about 16 minutes inline in 2026-11 (11 Rust, 5 Python), longer beside proof jobs; its cargo target directory is kept warm between runs
